description:
Compare complete ray-traced frames, excluding the project's busy-wait intro.

The saved fixture starts the existing 'start' receiver with the green flag,
disables Intro scripts, and replaces the outer forever with repeat 1. Rendering
procedures, assets, resolution, shadows, and quality settings are unchanged.
build: cargo build --release (default desktop features); helper profiling disabled
notes: Three alternating complete-frame runs per executable. Includes the original 0.25-second startup wait; excludes JIT compilation from elapsed. Procedural noise is randomized independently in each run. Headless computation, not displayed FPS.
